jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sentry

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

About the Role

A strong and reliable platform is essential to scaling Sentry for the future. Our Platform organization is responsible for everything that powers Sentry, from cloud infrastructure and streaming systems to storage, deployment, and security. We own the core services and technical foundations that enable every product and engineering team at Sentry to move fast and build with confidence.

We’re looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to set technical direction across Sentry’s Platform organization and lead engineering work spanning infrastructure, streaming, and storage.

Reporting directly to the VP of Platform Engineering, you’ll partner with engineering and product leaders to identify where our platform needs to evolve, make architectural decisions across team boundaries, and lead those changes through production delivery. You’ll stay hands-on through system design, prototyping, and code while helping senior and staff engineers lead work across teams.

What You’ll Do

  • Set technical direction for platform initiatives spanning multiple teams, connecting architectural decisions to product needs and business priorities.

  • Identify and lead changes addressing system bottlenecks, reliability risks, and architectural constraints.

  • Own cross-team initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation, rollout, and evaluation.

  • Make tradeoffs across reliability, performance, cost, operational complexity, and delivery speed.

  • Stay hands-on where your contribution matters most, writing code, building prototypes, and helping teams resolve difficult implementation problems.

  • Partner with engineering and product leaders to prioritize platform investments and sequence work across teams.

  • Guide major architectural decisions and help teams resolve disagreements with clear reasoning and evidence.

  • Mentor senior and staff engineers, strengthening their technical judgment and ability to lead across team boundaries.

How You Work

  • You bring structure to ambiguous problems and help teams agree on what to solve first.

  • You pair architectural judgment with hands-on engineering and ownership through delivery.

  • You build alignment across teams, challenge assumptions, and make decisions when priorities compete.

  • You favor simple, maintainable designs and understand when added complexity is necessary.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience setting technical direction across multiple engineering teams, aligning engineering and product leaders on architectural decisions, priorities, and tradeoffs.

  • Track record of leading complex, cross-team initiatives from problem definition through production delivery, with measurable improvements in reliability, scalability, performance, or engineering productivity.

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial hands-on experience architecting, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems.

  • Deep experience designing and operating production systems in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, with ownership of architectural decisions and their operational outcomes.

  • Strong hands-on software engineering skills, including writing production code and building prototypes to validate architectural approaches.

  • Deep expertise in one or more of the following areas, with working knowledge across others:

    • Cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, and infrastructure as code, such as Kubernetes and Terraform.

    • Event streaming and real-time processing systems, such as Kafka, Flink, or Beam.

    • Distributed storage and data systems, including OLAP/OLTP databases, blob storage, and caching.

  • Ability to explain complex technical tradeoffs, build alignment across teams and senior leadership, and resolve architectural disagreements.

  • Experience mentoring senior and staff engineers, strengthening their architectural judgment, and developing technical leadership across teams.

The base salary range Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $260,000 to $400,000, plus an annual performance bonus of up to 20% of base salary. A successful candidate’s actual base salary (or hourly wage) amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). See Sentry Benefits for more details about the Company’s benefit plans/programs.

Equal Opportunity at Sentry

Sentry is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to its employees and candidates for employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other legally-protected characteristic. This commitment includes the provision of reasonable accommodations to employees and candidates for employment with physical or mental disabilities who require such accommodations in order to (a) perform the essential functions of their jobs, or (b) seek employment with Sentry. We strive to build a diverse team, with an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive. Sentry is an open-source company because we believe that everyone, everywhere, should have the ability and tools to make great software. Software should be accessible. That starts with making our industry accessible.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations@sentry.io.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Foundational Storage
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sentry

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

About the role

Sentry’s Foundational Storage team builds and supports the stateful storage systems that all our products rely on: object storage, relational databases, key-value stores, and caches. We help Sentry engineers store and access data consistently, durably, securely, and efficiently as our products and traffic grow.

We develop storage services like our open-source Objectstore and build libraries and APIs that make existing storage systems easier to use. In our own services, we design storage protocols that keep data consistent across backends, even through concurrent updates and failures. Our abstractions let other engineering teams use storage without worrying about which cluster or instance holds their data.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you’ll work on both the systems and the code that makes them easy to use. You’ll tackle questions of data consistency, availability, performance, and cost-efficiency, and work with product teams to turn their needs into practical solutions. The goal is simple: make the right way to store data the easy and obvious way.

In this role you will

  • Design and operate storage systems used across Sentry, including their configuration and performance tuning.

  • Create APIs and abstractions that make storage easy for product teams to use, with best practices for correctness, security, and scale built in.

  • Solve storage challenges at scale, including consistency under concurrent access, sharding and rebalancing, and routing reads and writes across storage backends as workloads grow.

  • Work with product engineers to choose storage approaches, plan safe migrations, and help teams adopt the tools you build.

  • Plan and build with other Platform and Infrastructure teams, including analytical storage and streaming, to deliver a complete, fault-tolerant platform for product teams. Align roadmaps and standards, and design for failures and recovery.

  • Improve storage performance and cost efficiency by making better use of backends and resources, while keeping the platform simple for product teams.

  • Write code primarily in Rust and Python, with clear user-facing documentation. Develop advanced testing scenarios, such as production-scale chaos tests covering backend and infrastructure outages.

  • Own latency and availability SLOs for your services, improve monitoring and incident response, and participate in the team’s on-call rotation.

  • Work within Postsres and perform database tuning or query optimization

You’ll love this job if you

  • Enjoy digging into the internals of storage systems and understanding how they behave when traffic grows, requests race, or a dependency has a bad day.

  • Care about a useful, easy-to-use API as much as what happens behind it.

  • Like working with other engineers to understand their needs and make their day-to-day work easier.

  • Want to follow your work from design and code through rollout and production for millions of developers.

  • Want open-source contributions to be at the center of your day job.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building and operating distributed, stateful systems in production.

  • Hands-on experience with object storage, relational databases, OR caching systems at production scale. Experience with key-value or wide-column stores is a plus.

  • An understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, concurrency, and what happens when requests fail or need to be retried.

  • Proficiency in a systems language such as Go, C++, Java, or Rust, and comfort working in Python. We primarily use Rust and Python, and welcome engineers who are new to Rust.

  • Experience running services on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including observability, SLOs, and incident response. Familiarity with Terraform is a plus.

  • Good written and spoken English, especially in explaining technical choices and writing documentation.

  • Nice to have: experience building shared libraries or internal APIs, migrating data between systems, or improving system performance and cost.

 

The base salary range (or hourly wage range, if applicable) that Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $190,000 to $400,000 USD. A successful candidate’s actual base salary (or hourly wage) amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). See Sentry Benefits for more details about the Company’s benefit plans/programs.

Equal Opportunity at Sentry

Sentry is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to its employees and candidates for employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other legally-protected characteristic. That starts with making our industry accessible.

ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Sentry’s Foundational Storage team builds and supports the stateful storage systems that all our products rely on: object storage, relational databases, key-value stores, and caches. We help Sentry engineers store and access data consistently, durably, securely, and efficiently as our products and traffic grow.

We develop storage services like our open-source Objectstore https://github.com/getsentry/objectstore and build libraries and APIs that make existing storage systems easier to use. In our own services, we design storage protocols that keep data consistent across backends, even through concurrent updates and failures. Our abstractions let other engineering teams use storage without worrying about which cluster or instance holds their data.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you’ll work on both the systems and the code that makes them easy to use. You’ll tackle questions of data consistency, availability, performance, and cost-efficiency, and work with product teams to turn their needs into practical solutions. The goal is simple: make the right way to store data the easy and obvious way.


IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

 - Design and operate storage systems used across Sentry, including their configuration and performance tuning.

 - Create APIs and abstractions that make storage easy for product teams to use, with best practices for correctness, security, and scale built in.

 - Solve storage challenges at scale, including consistency under concurrent access, sharding and rebalancing, and routing reads and writes across storage backends as workloads grow.

 - Work with product engineers to choose storage approaches, plan safe migrations, and help teams adopt the tools you build.

 - Plan and build with other Platform and Infrastructure teams, including analytical storage and streaming, to deliver a complete, fault-tolerant platform for product teams. Align roadmaps and standards, and design for failures and recovery.

 - Improve storage performance and cost efficiency by making better use of backends and resources, while keeping the platform simple for product teams.

 - Write code primarily in Rust and Python, with clear user-facing documentation. Develop advanced testing scenarios, such as production-scale chaos tests covering backend and infrastructure outages.

 - Own latency and availability SLOs for your services, improve monitoring and incident response, and participate in the team’s on-call rotation.

 - Work within Postsres and perform database tuning or query optimization




YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

 - Enjoy digging into the internals of storage systems and understanding how they behave when traffic grows, requests race, or a dependency has a bad day.

 - Care about a useful, easy-to-use API as much as what happens behind it.

 - Like working with other engineers to understand their needs and make their day-to-day work easier.

 - Want to follow your work from design and code through rollout and production for millions of developers.

 - Want open-source contributions to be at the center of your day job.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience building and operating distributed, stateful systems in production.

 - Hands-on experience with object storage, relational databases, and caching systems at production scale. Experience with key-value or wide-column stores is a plus.

 - An understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, concurrency, and what happens when requests fail or need to be retried.

 - Proficiency in a systems language such as Go, C++, Java, or Rust, and comfort working in Python. We primarily use Rust and Python, and welcome engineers who are new to Rust.

 - Experience running services on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including observability, SLOs, and incident response. Familiarity with Terraform is a plus.

 - Good written and spoken English, especially in explaining technical choices and writing documentation.

 - Nice to have: experience building shared libraries or internal APIs, migrating data between systems, or improving system performance and cost.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sentry

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

About the role

Sentry is looking for a Manager, Design Engineering to lead the team behind Scraps, our design system. This role would manage a team of designers and front-end engineers that is building the infrastructure that powers our UI development.

This role lives at the intersection of design, engineering and AI tooling. The ideal candidate is comfortable reviewing a component's API in a pull request, can critique the consistency of typography across components, and has created skills to help agents use a design system more effectively. This role will set the direction for our system, grow the team, and stay close enough to the work to make design and implementation decisions.

In this role you will

  • Manage and grow a team of engineers and designers — hiring, leveling, and coaching across both crafts

  • Own the strategic roadmap for the team: what components to prioritize, what tools to adopt, which parts of the web app to refactor, etc.

  • Help maintain the UI quality and expression that Sentry is known for

  • Keep design and code in sync — tokens, variables, component parity, and the pipeline from Figma to production

  • Stay hands-on building components and the infrastructure to enable fast, accurate agentic front-end development and prototyping

  • Drive adoption across product teams through documentation, lint rules, and contribution workflows that don't slow anyone down

You'll love this job if you

  • Consider yourself a design engineer, or a designer who codes

  • Are passionate about design systems as the context layer for agentic frontend development, and want to build tools and skills that enable product teams to ship faster

  • Nerd out over component APIs, variant structures, and tokenization and naming conventions

  • Care deeply about consistency but know when a pattern needs to flex for a specific use case

  • Care deeply about interface quality, and want to build world class front-end infrastructure you can be proud of

  • Get as much out of growing people as you do out of building things

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in a full-time design system or design engineering team

  • 2+ years of people management experience

  • Strong visual and interaction design skills with a sharp eye for spacing, hierarchy, and micro-interactions

  • Deep fluency in React, TypeScript, CSS, and the DOM

  • Familiarity with Figma's design systems tooling — components, variants, variables, auto layout, shared libraries, and branching workflows

  • Able to balance long-term system thinking with the practical needs of product teams shipping on tight timelines

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Developer Infrastructure
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sentry

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

About the Role

The Developer Infrastructure team builds the systems Sentry engineers use to develop, test, and ship software. We own local and cloud development environments, CI/CD across our open-source and private codebases, tooling for creating new services, and SDK and library publishing.

Our goal is to help engineers spend more time building for customers and less time troubleshooting their development tools. You’ll work on problems such as shortening CI feedback cycles, improving deployment reliability, detecting flaky tests, and making development environments easier to use and maintain.

As AI coding agents become part of engineering workflows, you’ll also help our environments, CI, and deployment systems support them with the context and access they need.

You’ll own projects from design through rollout and ongoing operation, working directly with engineers across Sentry to understand their needs and measure whether your changes improve their work.

This role is based in San Francisco, with three days per week in the office to work closely with Platform and Product Engineering teams.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain tooling for local and cloud development environments.

  • Improve the speed and reliability of CI and deployment pipelines as our codebases and infrastructure grow.

  • Develop supported, reusable workflows for creating services and libraries.

  • Improve SDK and library publishing tools and release processes.

  • Build metrics, dashboards, and flaky test detection to help teams identify and resolve development and deployment problems.

  • Give engineers and AI coding agents the context they need to work within Sentry’s systems and conventions.

  • Partner with engineering teams to prioritize improvements, support adoption, and evaluate results.

How You Work

  • You enjoy building tools and infrastructure other engineers rely on.

  • You consider reliability, performance, cost, and maintenance when making technical decisions.

  • You take ownership from understanding a problem through implementation, rollout, and operation.

  • You listen to engineers’ feedback and use evidence to guide improvements.

  • You help teams adopt shared tools and standards through clear reasoning and collaboration.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience or equivalent experience building developer tools and infrastructure.

  • A track record of building or significantly improving developer tooling or infrastructure used by engineering teams.

  • Strong proficiency in Python.

  • Experience improving CI/CD systems, including diagnosing performance or reliability problems.

  • Experience leading complex technical projects through design, implementation, and rollout.

  • Experience using Docker and container orchestration in production.

  • Experience working with cloud infrastructure such as GCP or AWS.

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code tools.

  • Experience working across engineering teams to build agreement on tools, standards, or workflow changes.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical tradeoffs and documenting how systems work.

You don’t need to meet every qualification to apply. If your experience aligns with the core work, we’d like to hear from you.

The base salary range (or hourly wage range, if applicable) that Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $190,000 to $400,000 USD. A successful candidate’s actual base salary (or hourly wage) amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). See Sentry Benefits for more details about the Company’s benefit plans/programs.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sentry

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

About the role

At Sentry, Support is an engineering discipline. Our customers are developers, and they expect answers from people who can read their stack trace, open the SDK source, and tell them what's actually wrong.

We're hiring a Senior Manager to lead Support Engineering. You'll run the team that handles everything from a single developer's SDK question to a production incident at one of our largest enterprise customers. You'll also help drive how we use AI in support: what systems are used, how they best help customers, enable the teams, and how we know the answers they give are right and forward looking.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll manage people, set the support strategy, get face to face time with customers, while also getting into tickets when it matters.

In this role you will

Lead and grow the team

  • Manage and coach a team of Technical Support Engineers

  • Set clear expectations for technical depth, response quality, and ownership, and give direct feedback

  • Design a coverage model that works across time zones, including on-call and escalation paths

  • Build career paths for Support Engineers who want to go deeper technically, move into management, or move into different teams and practices

Own support outcomes

  • Own and report the team's core metrics: CX, time to resolution, escalation rate, and more

  • Use support conversations as a signal: find the top drivers of tickets and get them fixed in the product, the docs, internal operations, or the SDKs, not just answered faster

Run AI-assisted support

  • Own the roadmap for our support agents: which request types they handle, what context they need, and when they hand off to a person

  • Set the quality bar for agent answers and the process for catching incomplete ones

  • Decide where automation is worth building and where it isn't, based on data

Handle escalations and partner across Sentry

  • Run the escalation process with Engineering: make sure bugs reach the right team with a reproduction and clear impact, and that customers hear back

  • Be the support lead on high-stakes enterprise issues, working with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and Sales

  • Bring a clear picture of customer pain to Product and Engineering, backed by numbers

You'll love this job if you

  • Think great support is an engineering problem, not a staffing problem

  • Want to build the team and the systems at the same time

  • Can debug a tricky SDK issue yourself and also explain to a VP why their incident took four hours

  • Would rather fix the cause of 200 tickets than answer them faster

  • Have strong opinions on where AI helps in support and where it makes things worse, and be willing to discuss this at length.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in technical support, support engineering, or software engineering at a SaaS or developer tools company

  • 3+ years managing technical support engineers, including hiring and growing a team

  • Technically credible with senior engineers: comfortable reading code in at least a few of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Ruby, and debugging across frontend, backend, and infrastructure

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, APIs, and how observability tools (errors, tracing, logs) fit into them

  • Hands-on experience running AI or automation in a support org, and a clear view of its failure modes

  • Track record of using support data to drive product and process changes

  • Clear, direct written communication with customers, executives, and engineers

Bonus

  • Experience at a developer tools or observability company

  • Former software engineer

  • Managed a team spread across multiple time zones

  • Open source contributor or maintainer

A successful candidate’s actual base salary (or hourly wage) amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sentry

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

About the role:

Forward Deployed Engineers at Sentry help our largest customers get real value from Sentry, from integrating the SDK to making sure the right alerts and issues reach the right people at the right time. This role is a Senior Solutions Engineer who goes further: you'll help us build Sentry's forward deployed motion.

That means working shoulder to shoulder with our most important customers, often inside their codebases and workflows, instead of advising from the outside. When a customer's problem needs more than a best-practices doc, such as a custom integration, a tricky instrumentation setup, or a working prototype, you'll build it with them, then turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for the rest of the team.

Forward deployed work is new here and you will have a part in building this arm. You'll start with the core Solutions Engineering work and take on more hands-on deployment work as customers pull you into it, helping define what this motion looks like at Sentry. The goal is simple: reduce time to value. The outcomes we care about:

  • Developers can quickly find and resolve slowdowns and errors in their applications.

  • Customers get to value faster, and the lessons from each deployment make the product better for everyone.

 

In this role you will

  • Turn customer goals into a plan. Understand customers' pain points and objectives, then act as their trusted advisor, translating them into implementation plans, workshops, and best practices that show clear business value.

  • Get Sentry set up, in the code. With the customer's permission, work in their codebase like a member of their engineering team, delivering the pull requests that fully set up Sentry so data is flowing from day one.

  • Instrument what matters most. Add custom telemetry for a customer's most critical user journeys and build the dashboards and alerts that go with it.

  • Lead migrations. Move customers off their existing observability tools by setting up their Sentry organization and delivering PRs that introduce Sentry and remove the old solution.

  • Work like a trusted contractor. Stay within the scope and access you've been given, take extra care in live environments, test thoroughly, and ship pull requests that customer engineers are glad to merge. Embed with their teams, including on site, when it helps.

  • Build the motion. Turn one-off deployments into repeatable playbooks and tooling, help define how forward deployed engagements are scoped and measured, and bring what you learn back to Product and Engineering.

 

You’ll love this job if you

  • You'd rather sit with a customer's engineers and fix the problem in their code than write them a recommendation

  • Enjoy talking about technology and interfacing with engineers and engineering leaders.

  • Appreciate working in a dynamic environment, on a variety of projects with customers from lots of different industries.

  • Love flexing your creative brain by developing solutions, resources, and content from scratch (scripts, code samples, demos, sales-consumable collateral/documents, etc.).

  • Have a fast-paced, results-driven mindset.

  • Love developer tools, open-source, and/or all things software development life cycle!

 

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience, with some mixture being Software Engineering and Solutions Engineering/Implementation and at least 1+ year being a FDE

  • Hands-on experience working with programming languages and frameworks including JavaScript, Python, Node.js, Java, PHP, .NET, Ruby, React, React Native, Mobile Native (iOS and/or Android), etc

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with credibility in front of engineers and engineering leaders

  • Problem solver, knowledgable, and can-doer

  • Bonus: experience with observability, APM, or error monitoring tools, including migrating customers from another vendor, or helping build a forward deployed or customer engineering function

 

The total compensation range (or hourly wage range, if applicable) that Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $190,000 to $230,000 USD. A successful candidate’s actual base salary (or hourly wage) amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). See Sentry Benefits for more details about the Company’s benefit plans/programs.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Platform (Runtime & Stateful Systems)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sentry

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

About the role

We're looking for an experienced engineering leader to own one of the most critical areas within Platform: the runtime and stateful systems Sentry runs on. You'll lead multiple engineering teams and Staff engineers responsible for OLTP and OLAP databases, real-time compute and stream processing, blob storage, and distributed caching.

These systems power Sentry's products, including Seer, and are mission-critical to the business. When they perform well, every product team moves faster. When they don't, the whole company feels the impact.

You'll set the technical vision across these systems, lead significant architectural changes, and develop the engineering leaders and teams responsible for building and operating them. This role requires someone who brings deep technical judgment, thinks strategically, and has a track record of driving complex engineering initiatives from concept through execution.

You'll have the opportunity to shape both the technical direction and organizational growth of a critical part of Sentry's platform as our products and infrastructure continue to evolve.

This is a hybrid role based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with an expectation of working from our San Francisco office three days per week.

In This Role You Will

  • Lead multiple engineering teams and Staff engineers responsible for the runtime and stateful systems supporting Sentry, Seer, and the products built on top of them.

  • Set the technical vision and strategy across multiple systems, identifying opportunities to evolve our architecture as the business scales.

  • Drive significant architectural changes and technical initiatives, making informed tradeoffs around scalability, reliability, performance, cost, and complexity.

  • Provide technical leadership across teams, working closely with senior engineers to evaluate architectural decisions, challenge assumptions, and establish technical direction.

  • Own the execution and operational excellence of mission-critical systems, ensuring teams deliver reliable, scalable, and high-performing platform components.

  • Build and develop a strong engineering organization, including hiring, mentoring, and growing engineering managers and senior technical leaders.

  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence, technical accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Partner across Platform, Infrastructure, and Product to align priorities, navigate ambiguity, and deliver complex, cross-functional initiatives.

  • Anticipate evolving product and infrastructure needs, identifying opportunities to build new platform capabilities and improve existing systems.

You'll love this job if you

  • Enjoy solving complex distributed systems problems and have strong opinions about architecture, backed by experience and sound technical judgment.

  • Thrive in roles where you're equally responsible for technical direction, execution, and developing engineering leaders.

  • Like taking ownership of ambiguous technical challenges, establishing a clear strategy, and bringing teams together to execute.

  • Are passionate about building large-scale systems where reliability, performance, and efficiency directly impact the business.

  • Enjoy partnering with senior engineers, challenging technical assumptions, and helping teams make thoughtful architectural decisions.

  • Take pride in building high-performing teams, developing future leaders, and raising the engineering bar.

  • Want to shape the runtime foundation supporting Sentry's products and AI capabilities for years to come.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in backend, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with significant experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems.

  • Director-level engineering management experience, or equivalent senior engineering leadership experience overseeing multiple teams at comparable scale and complexity.

  • Deep technical expertise in at least one of the following domains:

    • OLTP databases

    • OLAP databases

    • Real-time compute and stream processing

    • Blob/object storage

    • Distributed caching

  • Demonstrated experience driving significant architectural changes, including evaluating technical tradeoffs, establishing direction, and leading implementation.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to engage deeply in architectural discussions across multiple distributed systems domains.

  • Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional engineering initiatives from strategy through execution, with measurable technical or business impact.

  • Experience hiring, developing, and leading engineering managers and senior technical talent.

  • Strong communication and organizational leadership skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts, influence senior stakeholders, and align teams around a shared strategy.

  • Experience operating mission-critical infrastructure with a strong understanding of reliability, scalability, performance, and operational efficiency.

The base salary range that Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $300,000 to $450,000 USD, plus an annual performance bonus of up to 20% of base salary. A successful candidate’s actual base salary amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). See Sentry Benefits for more details about the Company’s benefit plans/programs.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Size Analysis & Snapshots
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sentry

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

About the role

You’ll join the team behind Sentry’s Size Analysis and Snapshots, two products that check every pull request before it ships. Size Analysis breaks down iOS and Android builds to explain why an app got bigger. Snapshots catches unintended visual changes by diffing screenshots against a baseline. Both run in our customers’ CI, report straight to Source Code Management providers, and handle some of the heaviest payloads at Sentry: multi-GB app binaries and builds with tens of thousands of images.

In this role you will

You’ll work full-stack with a backend lean, owning features from the moment a build arrives from CI, to the moment when UI engineers use that data to decide whether to merge. You’ll own the codebase behind our mobile binary analysis and large-scale image comparison. You’ll share the pipeline, the GitHub integration and on-call with the rest of the Sentry team.

  • Build and tune the backend services and task-based pipelines that ingest, analyze and compare builds, with large artifacts in object storage, fast and reliable on multi-GB binaries and changesets with tens of thousands of screenshots

  • Extend our product: own the functionality end-to-end, react on feedback and come up with proposals for further product development.

  • Own the GitHub integration end to end: PR status checks, comments, approvals and webhooks, including races, duplicates and missing-baseline edge cases

  • Ship frontend features such as treemaps, build comparisons and diff viewers that stay fast on huge datasets

  • Run what you build: deploys across regions, metrics, logging and on-call, and be the person who debugs the weird customer build

You’ll love this job if you

  • Want your work to show up in the pull requests our customers open every day, not buried in a dashboard nobody checks

  • Like problems with real weight: a multi-GB IPA, tens of thousands of screenshots in a single build, a binary format with sparse documentation

  • Would rather own a feature from upload to UI than hand off half of it (end-to-end ownership)

  • Enjoy building for developers, who will tell you exactly what’s wrong and why

  • Want to help two products that started at a startup grow into core parts of Sentry

Qualifications

  • 3+ years building production web services, with strong Python (Django preferred) and a habit of typed, tested code

  • Working proficiency in React and TypeScript, enough to ship a full feature without handing off the frontend

  • Experience with async task systems and event pipelines (Kafka, task queues, worker pools), including idempotency, locking, retries and their failure modes

  • Experience with Postgres schema design and migrations that work under rolling deploys, plus pragmatic rollout habits like feature flags and revertable changes

  • A track record of performance work: profiling, parallelism, memory reduction and large-file streaming through object storage

  • Bonus points for:

    • Hands-on experience with mobile build artifacts and tooling (LIEF, bundletool, apksigner, link maps, DWARF, code signing)

    • Image processing or pixel-diff tooling

    • GitHub Apps or the Checks API

    • Data visualization, especially treemaps

    • Prior work on developer tools, CI or observability products

We are obliged by law to quote the minimum wage of EUR 60,844,-- gross per year for this position, in accordance with the respective collective agreement (IT-KV). The salary that Sentry offers you is adjusted to the current market situation and will be above the IT-KV.

A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sentry

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

About the Role

Sentry helps developers identify and resolve issues in their applications. Behind our products is a complex foundation of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and services that must perform reliably at scale.

Our Platform and Infrastructure Engineering teams build and operate the systems that power Sentry. From cloud infrastructure, distributed storage, and real-time event processing to service reliability, scalability, and developer productivity, these teams provide the technical foundation that enables our products and engineering organization to grow.

We're looking for Staff Software Engineers to tackle some of Sentry's most challenging infrastructure and distributed systems problems. Depending on your experience and interests, you might work on scaling our real-time event processing systems, improving the reliability and efficiency of our cloud infrastructure, or designing and building foundational services that support our products.

In this role, you'll have the autonomy to identify important technical problems, lead solutions from design through production, and influence engineering decisions beyond your immediate team. We're looking for engineers who enjoy solving difficult problems, remain hands-on with the systems they build, and take pride in delivering meaningful technical impact.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design, build, and operate reliable, scalable distributed systems that support Sentry's products and engineering teams.

  • Own technically complex projects from identifying problems and defining solutions through implementation, deployment, and production operations.

  • Solve challenging engineering problems involving system architecture, performance, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency.

  • Make thoughtful architectural decisions, evaluating tradeoffs between performance, complexity, maintainability, and long-term scalability.

  • Proactively identify technical challenges and opportunities for improvement, including problems without clearly defined requirements or established solutions.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering, contributing production-quality code, reviewing designs, and helping resolve complex technical issues.

  • Collaborate with engineers and technical leaders across teams to influence technical direction, establish engineering standards, and drive improvements.

  • Share technical knowledge, mentor other engineers, and help strengthen engineering practices across the organization.

You'll Love This Job If You

  • Enjoy solving difficult technical problems where the solution isn't immediately obvious.

  • Like designing and building systems that operate reliably at scale.

  • Thrive on taking ownership of complex engineering challenges, from initial design through production.

  • Balance hands-on engineering with technical leadership and enjoy influencing decisions without formal authority.

  • Think critically about architectural tradeoffs and favor pragmatic, maintainable solutions over unnecessary complexity.

  • Take initiative in identifying important problems rather than waiting for projects to be assigned.

  • Enjoy collaborating with talented engineers, sharing knowledge, and raising the bar for engineering quality.

  • Find satisfaction in shipping meaningful improvements and seeing the impact of your work in production.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong background in designing, building, and operating distributed systems or infrastructure.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Go, Java, or a comparable language.

  • Experience designing and implementing technically complex systems, with a track record of delivering meaningful engineering outcomes.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and services, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently own complex technical projects, navigate ambiguity, and drive solutions from design through production.

  • Deep technical experience in one or more of the following areas:

    • Cloud Infrastructure: Kubernetes, container orchestration, Terraform, infrastructure as code, networking, or service discovery.

    • Distributed Systems: Distributed architectures, fault tolerance, consistency, replication, or high-availability systems.

    • Data Infrastructure: Kafka, real-time streaming, distributed storage, OLAP/OLTP databases, or large-scale data processing.

    • Infrastructure Reliability: Observability, performance optimization, capacity planning, incident response, or production operations.

    • Developer Infrastructure: CI/CD systems, build and deployment infrastructure, developer environments, or internal developer platforms.

  • Strong architectural judgment, with the ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and design systems for reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, collaborate effectively, and influence technical decisions across engineering teams.

  • Experience improving engineering practices, sharing technical knowledge, or helping other engineers grow.

We recognize that strong engineers come from different backgrounds. You don't need experience in every technology or domain listed above. We're interested in candidates who bring meaningful technical depth, strong engineering judgment, and a track record of solving challenging problems.

A successful candidate’s actual base salary (or hourly wage) amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sentry

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

About the role

Sentry's Infrastructure Engineering team focuses on making operating Sentry simple, safe, and seamless for the rest of the engineering organization. The team builds and operates foundational infrastructure, internal control and configuration systems, and the tooling and automation that allow engineers to deploy, manage, and safely operate production services at scale without needing to understand the underlying infrastructure complexity.

As the Engineering Manager for Infrastructure Engineering, you'll lead a team of engineers building the foundational infrastructure, internal control systems, and developer-facing tools that enable Sentry's engineering teams to operate production services safely and efficiently at scale.

This team focuses on making infrastructure easier to use and manage through automation, self-service tooling, and software abstractions that reduce operational complexity. You'll be responsible for the team's technical direction, execution, reliability, and growth, while partnering with engineering teams across Sentry to identify and solve shared infrastructure challenges.

You'll work closely with leaders across Infrastructure, Platform, and Production Engineering to shape how Sentry scales its infrastructure and operational model as the company grows.

In this role you will

  • Lead a team of engineers building and evolving the shared infrastructure, internal control systems, and developer-facing tools that Sentry's engineering teams rely on.

  • Drive improvements to infrastructure automation, configuration management, production safety, and developer self-service, making complex infrastructure easier and safer to operate.

  • Define and execute the team's technical roadmap, working with senior engineers to make sound architectural decisions and prioritize investments in reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

  • Develop engineers at different levels through coaching, mentorship, clear expectations, and opportunities for technical growth and ownership.

  • Build a healthy, high-performing team culture focused on accountability, continuous improvement, and delivering measurable impact.

  • Partner with Production Engineering, SRE, Developer Infrastructure, and other engineering teams to identify shared infrastructure challenges, establish standards, and improve developer workflows.

  • Balance operational needs with longer-term platform investments, reducing manual work and building scalable solutions rather than relying on one-off fixes.

  • Own the reliability, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the team's platforms and tools, ensuring they deliver meaningful value to the engineers who depend on them.

You'll love this job if you

  • Enjoy building infrastructure platforms and tools that make operating complex production systems simpler for other engineers.

  • Like solving infrastructure challenges through software engineering, automation, and self-service abstractions rather than relying on manual operations.

  • Believe in using proven technologies and choosing reliable, maintainable solutions over unnecessary complexity.

  • Think about scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency from the beginning, and prefer building solutions that serve many engineering teams rather than one.

  • Enjoy working across engineering organizations, understanding different teams' needs, and influencing technical decisions and platform adoption.

  • Take pride in developing engineers, building strong teams, and creating opportunities for people to take on greater technical ownership.

  • Value clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and delivering infrastructure improvements that make a lasting difference.

  • Want to work on technically challenging infrastructure problems while helping shape the team's long-term direction.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, ideally with a focus on infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, distributed systems, or infrastructure automation.

  • 4+ years of engineering management experience, including leading, developing, and growing teams of software engineers.

  • Experience leading the architecture, development, or evolution of shared infrastructure platforms, internal developer platforms, or distributed production systems.

  • Strong software engineering foundation, with experience in backend or systems programming languages such as Python, Go, Rust, or similar.

  • Hands-on technical experience with cloud infrastructure and familiarity with Kubernetes, Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tooling, and infrastructure automation.

  • Experience building or operating production infrastructure, with an understanding of reliability, scalability, operational risk, and incident management.

  • Demonstrated ability to define technical direction, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, and lead complex engineering initiatives from planning through delivery.

  • Experience coaching engineers, developing technical leaders, and building healthy, accountable engineering teams.

  • Strong technical communication skills and a track record of influencing decisions and aligning priorities across engineering teams and leadership.

  • Comfortable working across organizational boundaries and partnering with infrastructure, platform, and product engineering teams.

A successful candidate’s actual base salary (or hourly wage) amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Data Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sentry

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

About the role

Sentry helps over 4 million developers understand and resolve issues in their applications. Behind every error, performance trace, replay, and log is a large-scale data platform responsible for storing, querying, and analyzing massive volumes of telemetry data.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Events Analytics Platform (EAP) team, which builds and operates the distributed data systems powering Sentry's products. The team manages petabytes of data and develops high-performance analytical infrastructure using technologies like ClickHouse, enabling fast, complex queries across billions of records.

As Sentry grows, so do the technical challenges. The team is evolving its storage and query infrastructure to support increasing data volumes, more complex analytical workloads, and unified access to different types of telemetry data. EAP also provides the data foundation for Seer, Sentry's AI-powered debugging agent, enabling AI systems to access the production context needed to investigate and resolve issues.

In this role, you'll lead a team of engineers tackling complex distributed systems challenges while balancing architectural improvements with the reliability and performance of production systems. You'll bring strong technical judgment, guide engineering decisions, and work closely with product engineering teams to build capabilities that directly impact the developer experience.

This is an opportunity to lead a critical part of Sentry's infrastructure, solve challenging problems at scale, and shape how developers and AI-powered tools interact with application data.

What you'll do

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers working on large-scale distributed data systems, fostering technical excellence, ownership, collaboration, and professional growth.

  • Drive technical execution and architectural decisions across EAP's storage and query infrastructure, balancing scalability, reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.

  • Build and evolve analytical data systems supporting complex queries, high-throughput workloads, and efficient access to petabytes of event data.

  • Guide the evolution of EAP's architecture, including query optimization, storage and compute separation, and the unification of different event types into a common analytical platform.

  • Own the operational health of the platform, leading efforts to improve reliability, troubleshoot production issues, manage incidents, and address scaling challenges.

  • Partner with product engineering teams to understand their technical requirements, make informed tradeoffs, and deliver platform capabilities that support new product experiences.

  • Support Sentry's AI-powered capabilities by ensuring the platform efficiently serves the analytical workloads and production context required by Seer and other AI-driven experiences.

  • Set clear priorities and drive projects from design through production, helping the team execute effectively while managing competing technical and product needs.

You'll love this job if you

  • Enjoy leading engineers while staying closely involved in technical discussions, architecture, and complex problem-solving.

  • Get excited about building and operating large-scale distributed systems where performance, reliability, and efficiency matter.

  • Have a strong interest in analytical databases, storage engines, query systems, and the engineering challenges behind processing massive volumes of data.

  • Like working through difficult technical tradeoffs and turning ambiguous requirements into practical engineering solutions.

  • Take pride in building reliable production systems, understanding how they behave under load, and continuously improving their performance.

  • Enjoy collaborating with product engineering teams and understanding how infrastructure decisions influence the end-user experience.

  • Want to lead a team whose work directly supports Sentry's core products and growing AI-powered capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Significant professional software engineering experience, including experience managing and developing engineers, leading technical projects, and driving engineering execution.

  • Strong technical background in distributed systems, data infrastructure, analytical databases, or large-scale backend systems.

  • Hands-on experience building, scaling, or operating complex data-intensive systems, with depth in at least one of the following:

    • Analytical database infrastructure: Operating, scaling, optimizing, or maintaining OLAP systems such as ClickHouse, Apache Pinot, Apache Druid, or similar technologies in production.

    • Complex distributed data platforms: Designing and building sophisticated systems using analytical databases or distributed storage technologies as foundational components, with meaningful ownership of the underlying architecture, performance, and reliability.

  • Experience making architectural decisions and technical tradeoffs involving system scalability, performance, reliability, or operational complexity.

  • Demonstrated ownership of production systems, including troubleshooting, incident response, performance optimization, and operational improvements.

  • Experience leading engineering projects from technical design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing operations.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work with cross-functional stakeholders and translate technical requirements into actionable engineering priorities.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with ClickHouse, Pinot, Druid, or other column-oriented analytical databases.

  • Experience with query optimization, analytical storage architecture, or high-throughput data processing.

  • Experience building infrastructure for observability, telemetry, developer tools, or event-driven applications.

  • Experience working closely with product engineering teams to develop infrastructure supporting customer-facing features.

  • Proficiency with Python, Rust, or similar backend programming languages.

Not sure if you meet 100% of the qualifications? We encourage you to apply anyway. We're interested in people who are excited about this opportunity and eager to grow.

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Sentry helps over 4 million developers understand and resolve issues in their applications. Behind every error, performance trace, replay, and log is a large-scale data platform responsible for storing, querying, and analyzing massive volumes of telemetry data.



We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Events Analytics Platform (EAP) team, which builds and operates the distributed data systems powering Sentry's products. The team manages petabytes of data and develops high-performance analytical infrastructure using technologies like ClickHouse, enabling fast, complex queries across billions of records.



As Sentry grows, so do the technical challenges. The team is evolving its storage and query infrastructure to support increasing data volumes, more complex analytical workloads, and unified access to different types of telemetry data. EAP also provides the data foundation for Seer, Sentry's AI-powered debugging agent, enabling AI systems to access the production context needed to investigate and resolve issues.



In this role, you'll lead a team of engineers tackling complex distributed systems challenges while balancing architectural improvements with the reliability and performance of production systems. You'll bring strong technical judgment, guide engineering decisions, and work closely with product engineering teams to build capabilities that directly impact the developer experience.



This is an opportunity to lead a critical part of Sentry's infrastructure, solve challenging problems at scale, and shape how developers and AI-powered tools interact with application data.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead and develop a team of engineers working on large-scale distributed data systems, fostering technical excellence, ownership, collaboration, and professional growth.

 - Drive technical execution and architectural decisions across EAP's storage and query infrastructure, balancing scalability, reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability.

 - Build and evolve analytical data systems supporting complex queries, high-throughput workloads, and efficient access to petabytes of event data.

 - Guide the evolution of EAP's architecture, including query optimization, storage and compute separation, and the unification of different event types into a common analytical platform.

 - Own the operational health of the platform, leading efforts to improve reliability, troubleshoot production issues, manage incidents, and address scaling challenges.

 - Partner with product engineering teams to understand their technical requirements, make informed tradeoffs, and deliver platform capabilities that support new product experiences.

 - Support Sentry's AI-powered capabilities by ensuring the platform efficiently serves the analytical workloads and production context required by Seer and other AI-driven experiences.

 - Set clear priorities and drive projects from design through production, helping the team execute effectively while managing competing technical and product needs.




YOU'LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

 - Enjoy leading engineers while staying closely involved in technical discussions, architecture, and complex problem-solving.

 - Get excited about building and operating large-scale distributed systems where performance, reliability, and efficiency matter.

 - Have a strong interest in analytical databases, storage engines, query systems, and the engineering challenges behind processing massive volumes of data.

 - Like working through difficult technical tradeoffs and turning ambiguous requirements into practical engineering solutions.

 - Take pride in building reliable production systems, understanding how they behave under load, and continuously improving their performance.

 - Enjoy collaborating with product engineering teams and understanding how infrastructure decisions influence the end-user experience.

 - Want to lead a team whose work directly supports Sentry's core products and growing AI-powered capabilities.

 - Significant professional software engineering experience, including experience managing and developing engineers, leading technical projects, and driving engineering execution.

 - Strong technical background in distributed systems, data infrastructure, analytical databases, or large-scale backend systems.

 - Experience working closely with product engineering teams to develop infrastructure supporting customer-facing features.

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Detection & Response
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sentry

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

About The Role

The Security Team is responsible for securing all things Sentry: our customers, our code, and everything in between. We are a small but growing team with broad scope, high trust, and the autonomy to tackle hard security problems with creativity and an engineering mindset. We work at a company with a strong developer culture, building a product that millions of developers genuinely love and rely on. That context shapes everything about how we operate.

We take a pragmatic approach to preventing and responding to security risks. In this role not only will you build and contribute to systems which detect malicious activity, you will have the unique opportunity to implement new controls to prevent future incidents. You will work across detection and response and corporate security domains. You'll contribute to practices that keep Sentry secure as we grow: alert triage for corporate and production, detection engineering, deploying preventative controls, identity and access management, investigations and incident response, and more.

You'll partner with teams across the company to prevent and respond to security incidents. You will work as a technical collaborator who prioritizes preventative controls, defense in depth, and high signal alerting practices. As Sentry expands our agentic product capabilities and development practices, you'll also find yourself at the frontier of a new set of security approaches and challenges.

In this role, you will

  • Maintain, improve, and own detection engineering systems. We own and operate our own detection stack and are building agentic triage with thoughtful security response and orchestration automation.

  • Perform investigations, and contribute to security incident response. You will assist and contribute to a breadth of incident types, or Sentry and our customers.

  • Contribute to, maintain, and operate identity and access management systems. Access management is a critical component of our security program.

  • Have a lot of opportunity to grow and learn across many security domains. We are a highly cross-functional team and you will have opportunities to touch adjacent security projects spanning appsec, infrasec, governance, and privacy.

  • Research, identify, and respond to emerging threats relevant to Sentry. We build and operate a complex application and cloud environment, including the novel attack surface introduced by Sentry's agentic product features and AI-assisted engineering practices.

You’ll thrive in this role if you

  • Enjoy operating cross-functionally, building relationships, and influencing with technical expertise as you protect a fast-moving engineering organization.

  • Get excited when something new lands on your desk, be it an interesting breach, a sweet exploit, a novel agentic architecture, an unfamiliar cloud primitive, or a bug class you haven't seen before.

  • Love working in a developer-forward culture where your colleagues are builders who care deeply about code quality and customer satisfaction.

  • Reach for automation first, you'd rather build a scalable, systematic solution to a security problem than make a noisy reactive solution which requires manual triage.

  • Thrive with ownership and want more of it, you prefer to drive work end-to-end, and you're energized by the autonomy — and the mentorship — that comes with being on a small, high-trust team.

Qualifications

  • 2-5 years of industry experience in a detection and response, corporate security, or generalist security engineering role

  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field, equivalent training, or professional experience

  • Hands-on experience with several of the following: alert triage, detection tuning and writing, detection-as-code, security log ingestion, investigations and security incident response, identity and access management (IAM), phishing response, user access reviews, managing endpoint detection and response tooling

  • Experienced and comfortable programing in at least one language (Python preferred) and comfortable using agentic development workflows

  • Familiarity with operating distributed cloud technology (AWS, CICD, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, etc.) and experience with corporate (SSO, SAML, IAM) and defensive security tooling (EDR, SIEM, CNAPP, ZTNA, etc.)

  • A collaborative approach to problem solving paired with strong written and verbal communication

Not sure if you meet 100% of the qualifications? We encourage you to apply anyway. We're interested in people are excited about this opportunity and eager to grow.

The base salary range (or hourly wage range, if applicable) that Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $162,000 to $200,000 CAD. A successful candidate’s actual base salary (or hourly wage) amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Sentry

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.

About the role

The Streaming Platform team at Sentry is building the next generation of infrastructure that powers our ingestion pipelines and real-time data processing systems. Our platform ingests, processes, and distributes hundreds of thousands of events per second with low latency and high reliability. We are creating a system that makes it easy for Sentry engineers to deploy and run Streaming Applications at scale by simplifying the complexity of Kafka, scaling consumers automatically, and managing state so product teams can focus on building great experiences for developers.

As part of this team, you will work on challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data processing, and developer experience. You will help us create a self-service streaming platform that improves stability, accelerates time to production, and reduces operational overhead.

In this role you will

  • Design, build, and operate components of our Streaming Platform, including Kafka, the streaming runtime, high-level APIs, and developer-facing abstractions.

  • Implement resilient, high-throughput stream processing systems that handle unbounded datasets with strong correctness guarantees (delivery, checkpointing, watermarking, and more).

  • Build scalable automation and control plane for Kafka fleet management and improve efficiency.

  • Partner with product engineers to ensure our abstractions enable fast, reliable, and consistent ingestion pipelines.

  • Improve observability, monitoring, and failover for mission-critical real-time systems.

You’ll love this job if you

  • You enjoy working on distributed systems at scale and care about reliability and performance.

  • You like building abstractions that make complex infrastructure easier for others to use.

  • You are motivated by designing systems that balance flexibility for developers with best practices for stability.

  • You are excited to shape how Sentry handles near real-time ingestion and analytics at scale.

  • You value being part of a collaborative team where your contributions make a broad impact across the company.

Qualifications

  • At least 2-3 years of software engineering experience, with background in distributed systems, data infrastructure, or real-time streaming.

  • Proficiency in a programming language such as Python, Rust, Go, or Java (we primarily use Python and Rust, but experience in similar languages is valuable).

  • Experience building and operating systems in cloud environments such as Kubernetes, AWS, or GCP.

  • Nice to have: experience with streaming technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, or similar tools.

The Streaming Platform team at Sentry is building the next generation of infrastructure that powers our ingestion pipelines and real-time data processing systems. Our platform ingests, processes, and distributes hundreds of thousands of events per second with low latency and high reliability. We are creating a system that makes it easy for Sentry engineers to deploy and run Streaming Applications at scale by simplifying the complexity of Kafka, scaling consumers automatically, and managing state so product teams can focus on building great experiences for developers.

 - Partner with product engineers to ensure our abstractions enable fast, reliable, and consistent ingestion pipelines.

 - Improve observability, monitoring, and failover for mission-critical real-time systems.
